title: Dog at Sunset Concert
description: A large black and brown dog with a collar and tag sits in the foreground amid pink flowers, looking directly at the viewer. Behind the dog, a massive crowd faces a stage under a stone archway with a dramatic sunset, city skyline, and a large yellow sun in the sky.
prompt: A large black and brown dog with a silver tag collar sits in the foreground surrounded by pink clouds of flowers, staring at the viewer with big brown eyes. Behind it, a huge outdoor concert crowd faces a stage under an enormous stone archway. Dramatic sunset with a giant glowing yellow sun, orange and red sky, distant city skyline on hills, colorful flowers in foreground, vibrant and surreal atmosphere, detailed painting style.
